title: Radiomics of pulmonary nodules and lung cancer

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Radiomics of pulmonary nodules and lung cancer》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Radiomics is a developing field aimed at deriving automated quantitative imaging features from medical images that can predict nodule and tumour behavior non-invasively.
